[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] '''Jimayne''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] who was stationed on board the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]] during its construction over [[Despayre]]. He was informed about the movements of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] around the station.
